data.one_liner: An extension library for Flutter Tabs, TabBar, and TabView with advanced scrolling support.
data.what_it_does: Provides extended versions of Flutter's Tab, TabBar, and TabBarView widgets. It supports scrolling ancestor or child tabs when overscrolling, setting custom scroll directions, defining cache extents, and rendering custom tab indicators like carousel and color fill styles.
use_when: You need nested or linked tab views that scroll together during overscroll.
You want to configure vertical tab bars and tab views.
You need page caching or custom tab indicator styles like carousel indicators.
avoid_when: Standard Flutter TabBar and TabBarView fully meet your application's requirements.
You do not use tabs in your UI design.
strengths: Supports linked scrolling between ancestor and child tabs.
Allows setting custom scroll direction and page cache extent.
Includes built-in custom indicators like CarouselIndicator and ColorTabIndicator.
weaknesses: Relies on extensions of standard Flutter components which might require adjustments on Flutter SDK upgrades.
Documentation outside of README examples is minimal.
data.minimal_example:
ExtendedTabBarView(
  children: <Widget>[
    List("Tab000"),
    List("Tab001"),
  ],
  controller: tabController2,
  link: true,
  cacheExtent: 1,
)
